title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Saturday, 28 November 2026
description: OpenAI rolls out its new Astra and Sol models, Virgin Australia pushes for long-term approval of expanded Qatar Airways-linked Doha flights, Queensland communities clean up after a major storm as the Bureau warns of a volatile severe weather season, and the Gold Coast approves a $200 million Surfers Paradise tower. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
